title: Angleton probably leaked the MJ12 documents

tellings.quote: is probably responsible for the MJ12 docks getting leaked

related.note: Both concern Angleton's part in the MJ12 documents. This telling says Angleton probably leaked them, per Malmgren; the story says his chop shop made them and a DIA officer passed them on.

plain: James Jesus Angleton, the CIA's longtime head of counterintelligence, was probably the person behind the leak of the MJ12 documents, papers that describe a secret group of twelve officials said to handle crashed UFOs. Michels says this was passed on to him by Harold Malmgren, a former senior Washington official, who told him Angleton "is probably responsible for the MJ12 docs getting leaked." If so, the papers would have come out of the heart of the intelligence world on purpose.
